notes.subject: ol i stap liklik long vale bilong ol
notes.rationale: שארית עמקם: 'remnant of their valley' (apposition, YLT) vs 'with the remnant of their valley' (KJV); mi bihainim apposition.

notes.subject: katim skin bilong yu yet
notes.rationale: תתגודדדי: gadad — pasin bilong ol heven man i katim skin bilong ol long sori (Lo 14:1 i tambuim), o 'ol i bung wantaim ol'? — mi holim pasin bilong katim skin.

notes.subject: ol i stap liklik long vale
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long ol manmeri bilong vale bilong Filistia.

translation: Karaha i kam long Aza; Ashkelon i lus maus — ol i stap liklik long vale bilong ol. Sol wanem taim yu bai katim skin bilong yu yet?

tokens.gloss: yu bai katim skin bilong yu yet
